notes.text: This operation uses UAPI status as the feature-access result: inspect responseMeta()->uapiStatus() after the call (1 means enabled; 0 means absent or disabled). A UAPI status of 0 is accepted; an outer WHM bridge failure still throws.

The pinned data schema is a nullable opaque object, with null in the documented access examples. Preserve explicit null and object fields; absent data is a payload mismatch. No boolean payload is invented.
Observed data may also be an integer of unspecified meaning. Preserve the integer without inferring a closed flag enum or converting numeric strings; the feature-access result remains UAPI status.
